My story

The story behind
Me To You Designs

“It all started with a photo edit of my dad and my daughter. I lost my dad when I was 17 and pregnant, and my daughter never had the chance to meet him.”

That first edit meant a lot to me, and it ended up being the little beginning of something I never expected to grow into a business. From there, I started creating more personalised pieces and slowly built Me To You Designs into what it is today.

Why the name Me To You?

The name actually came from my best friend. I had been known as Made With Love, but I wanted a name that felt more personal and had a meaning behind it. My best friend helped me come up with Me To You, and it just stuck. It feels right because every order really is something made by me, especially for you.

What I love making

Personalised clothing and pyjamas have to be some of my favourites. I love taking an idea, a theme or someone's personality and turning it into something they can actually wear and enjoy. I also love balloon stacks, and although arches have definitely challenged me while I have been learning, I am starting to really enjoy creating them too.

Memorial prints are another important part of what I offer. They can be some of the hardest pieces to create because old photographs are not always easy to work with, and sometimes an edit simply does not go exactly to plan. But when it comes together and means something to somebody, it makes all the time and effort worthwhile.

Why I do it

For me, the best part is seeing the final product come together and knowing I have helped someone. I try to keep my prices as reasonable as I can because I know how quickly celebrations can become expensive. I want my customers to feel excited about their order and, hopefully, like I have taken a little bit of weight off their shoulders without them having to spend a fortune.

Birthday creations and seasonal designs are probably my favourite things to work on, but I am always learning, trying new ideas and expanding what I can offer. It is just me behind Me To You Designs, and that is something I am proud of.
